found_values.value: 250 mA nominal, 233 mA to 267 mA: above the encoder's steady 160 mA at 5 V and 100 mA at 12 V (V102). It is the encoder converter's own output current limit, in both jumper positions, because the F4 jumper selects the converter's feedback divider; the converter runs from the input bus, so a short on the encoder cable leaves the 5 V rail and the display supply untouched. report.value: No part read meets every value of the pack disconnect, so the function has no shortlist. R5460N212AF-TR-FE fails V107 with a charger connected: its unbalance operation turns DOUT back on after 89 ms to 167 ms when one cell reads over-discharge, the other over-charge and a charger is present, and 'the external FETs do not turn off at the same time' in any version; an open mid wire biased either way gives exactly that reading at any pack above 7.29 V, and R7's charger is present whenever USB-C is. MAX17320G22+ (option (b), already on the pack as R7's protector) states no behaviour for an open cell tap, releases undervoltage on a charger alone and states currents only as typical (16 uA Protect, 2.2 uA undervoltage shutdown). For the owner: accept V107 as 'yes only without a charger', add a round 2 circuit that removes the charger's presence signal while the balance lead is absent, or take option (b) with the open-tap behaviour measured

report.value: The F4 jumper switches the encoder converter's feedback divider between 5 V and 12 V, so its own limit (233 mA to 267 mA, V108) covers both positions and the 5 V rail carries the display alone. The encoder's power-on inrush (about 9 A for 0.3 ms, V102) runs into that limit for about 11.6 ms. TPS55288RPMR: HICCUP resets to 1 and turns the output off for 76 ms whenever it sits under 0.8 V at the limit, so firmware clears HICCUP before it sets OE (OE resets to 0); it answers at 74h or 75h, the pair the TPS55285 uses, so the two take opposite addresses. LM5175PWPR and LM5176PWPR set hiccup off with the MODE resistor and need no firmware
report.source: https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55288.pdf SLVSF01B 7.3.16, register 06h (15:32:08Z); lm5175.pdf SNVSA37A, lm5176.pdf SNVSAI1D pin functions MODE (15:32:09Z); Omron E6B2-C note *1 (15:31:45Z)
